title: DrewBrews Trend Radar feed
description: Contract between scout.mjs (writer) and the DrewBrews Trend Studio (reader). v1, with optional image fields (v1.1, backwards compatible — schemaVersion stays 1).

source_url.description: The EXACT page the buzz came from — a specific thread / watch?v= video / article. Not a homepage, channel, or subreddit root.

image_url.description: OPTIONAL. The article's og:image, downloaded into the radar repo and served from GitHub Pages (hotlinked images export blank from the Story Kit). See RADAR_IMAGES_SPEC.md.

image_origin.description: REQUIRED when image_url is set. The URL the image was downloaded from before re-hosting. The Studio decides rights from this host; a self-hosted image without it is reference-only.

image_license.description: OPTIONAL. 'press' ONLY when the image comes from the maker's own domain. The Studio re-checks the domain and fails safe.
